item.title: Starlink Eyes Malaysia D2C Trial as APAC Accelerates Satellite-to-Mobile Rollout
item.summary: Starlink has proposed a trial of its direct-to-cell (D2C) satellite service in Malaysia to expand mobile coverage in remote areas, as satellite-to-mobile connectivity gains momentum across the Asia Pacific.
